CDS Protocol P - Brain / Cognitive Support

Protocol cds protocol brain cognitive

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Cognitive support protocol using CDS for brain health and neuroprotection.

Indications

  • Cognitive support
  • Brain health
  • Neuroprotection
  • Mental clarity

Steps

  1. Prepare brain support dose
  2. Follow support protocol
  3. Monitor cognitive function
  4. Track symptoms
  5. Adjust as needed

Dosage

Brain support protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 1-2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Cognitive support
  • Brain health
  • Neuroprotection
  • Mental clarity

Monitoring

  • Monitor cognitive function
  • Track symptoms
  • Watch for changes
  • Medical supervision if needed

Frequency: 1-2 times daily
